newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville lowers power prices $9-10 per MWh.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville lowers power prices $9-10 per MWh.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) lowered offer prices for Tuesday deliveries by $9.00 to $10.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), the federal agency said Monday.
BPA, which posted prices for Tuesday through Thursday pre-schedulings, continued to offer firm and non-firm power during both peak and off-peak hours.
Tuesday firm power during off-peak hours was offered at $13.00 per MWh for both Northwest and California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries, down from $23.00 for Monday.
On-peak firm power for Thursday was offered at $21.00 in the Northwest and $22.00 at COB, compared with $30.00 and $31.00, respectively, for Monday.
Non-firm off-peak power for Tuesday was offered at $14.00 to $17.00 per MWh, while on-peak offers were $21.00 to $22.00.
